about_the_game:
Grandma Studios proudly presents a journey into the unknown with The Unseen Fears: Inner Darkness!

Warning: This game features moments of darkness and terror that some may find distressing.

A desperate family needs your help, as their daughter has been seeing horrifying visions that most have chalked up to simple hallucinations. But following your instincts and unique abilities, you soon begin to suspect that the young girl’s visions just might be coming from something else. Follow the clues and push on with your investigation against all odds to find the source of this madness. Who really knows the truth? How deep does it go? Find out in this brand-new hidden object masterpiece!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Explore the origins of a mysterious artifact in the bonus game!

  • Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games, earn achievements, solve a jigsaw puzzle, and play a hidden chapter!

  • Tons of puzzle pieces and morphing objects to find!

  • Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, videos, and more!

  • Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game - a sub genre of point & click adventure. Follow protagonists on a story-driven quest, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve various puzzles to advance the plot.
